title: Adam-Smith at SemEval-2023 Task 4: Discovering Human Values in Arguments with Ensembles of Transformer-based Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and classifying human values (such as benevolence, tradition, and humility) within textual arguments. It specifically evaluates its performance using the 'Nahj al-Balagha' dataset, which is composed of Islamic religious texts, to test the system's robustness in religious and moral domains.
